name: Encrypted Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Encrypted Rune calls promising new rogues to Anvilmar. Its message bids them decipher the words and seek out Solm Hargrin.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: A new rogue must read thieves' cant to understand the rune. In doing so, they meet the shadowy craft needed to survive Dun Morogh's harsh wilderness. Its ciphers bear a private summons from Solm Hargrin, the rogue mentor in Anvilmar, for those who show promise in stealth and cunning.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Deciphering the rune leads new rogues to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar. He hopes to strengthen the valley's covert ranks as local tensions rise. Solm teaches bladecraft and stealth, but also vigilance and camaraderie. With peace strained, rogues need to stand together.

faq.answer: The Encrypted Rune carries a coded message for fledgling rogues in Coldridge Valley. It directs them to report to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar for training.
Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer in Anvilmar, sends the Encrypted Rune to summon new recruits quietly.

faq.q: Where should I take the rune?
aliases: who do i bring it to
faq.answer: Take the deciphered instructions to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley.
The cipher lets only an aspiring rogue who can read it heed the call. It keeps rogue methods out of plain view.

angles.text: As a rogue, you meet Dun Morogh's rogues through this first formal contact. Your training begins in stealth, quick blades, and survival.
As a dwarf, you are another child of Ironforge in Coldridge Valley. The rune calls you to master the shadows and protect the clan's interests from beneath the surface.
